label: Называть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for называть (to call, to name).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Называю' is the 1sg present of imperfective называть, with the regular -ю on the называ- stem. It means 'I call by name', taking an accusative object plus name.

Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Называешь' is the 2sg present of называть with -ешь. The idiom 'называть вещи своими именами' means to call things by their proper names, to speak plainly.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Называет' is the 3sg present of называть with -ет. With reflexive 'себя' plus instrumental it means he calls himself a great artist.

missions.phrase: Мы называем этот город вторым домом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Называем' is the 1pl present of называть with -ем. The construction takes an accusative object and an instrumental, calling the city a second home.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Называют' is the 3pl present of называть with -ют, closing the present ladder. The instrumental 'Сашей' gives the familiar name friends use for him.

missions.phrase: Раньше я называл его лучшим другом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Называл' is the past m. sg. of imperfective называть. The imperfective and 'раньше' frame a habitual past way of referring to someone.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Называла' is the past f. sg. of называть with -ла. The imperfective marks a recurring tender habit, with the instrumental 'солнышком' as the affectionate name.

Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Называли' is the past pl. of называть with -ли. The imperfective reports an ongoing reputation, with the instrumental 'странным человеком' as what they called him.

Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Называй' is the informal command of imperfective называть, formed from the present stem называ- plus -й. Negated, it asks someone to stop addressing me by surname.

missions.phrase: Я буду называть тебя по имени.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Буду называть' joins 'буду' with the infinitive называть, the standard imperfective future. The perfective partner назвать would instead mark one act of naming.
